# Word Game Data

> Open data and small open-source tools for Wordle, Scrabble and other word games, by David James of thewordfinder.io. Word lists from ENABLE (public domain); code MIT-licensed. AI search, answers and training are allowed.

## Key facts
- Every one of the 8,613 allowed Wordle guesses was scored against 1,574 everyday answers by how many answers remain after one guess (lower is better).
- Best opener: RAISE (37.8 answers left on average). CRANE 48.3, ADIEU 80.8, AUDIO 124.0.
- Best fixed second word after RAISE: DONUT (4.1 left); after CRANE: TOILS (3.4 left).
- 8,613 five-letter words, 106 two-letter words and 31 Q-without-U words in the ENABLE-based list.
